chartPattern.confirm: a close below the ~$58.66 support line
chartPattern.explanation: Price has established a flat support around $58.66-$58.75 since June 9, while forming a series of lower highs from ~$62.08 on June 8 to ~$59.33 on June 10, indicating sellers are gaining control.
chartPattern.signal: A confirmed breakdown below the support could signal a continuation of the downtrend with a potential move towards the measured target price. This is a bearish continuation pattern in the context of the overall downtrend since early May.

news.paragraph: The iShares Silver Trust (SLV) has experienced a significant downturn, trading down nearly 50% from its peak and on track to close below a crucial level for the first time in over a year. This slide follows a sharp 16% drop in AGQ, a silver-leveraged ETF, and comes as traders eye May inflation data for potential market direction. The current price action suggests a bearish sentiment, with questions arising about whether this represents a buying opportunity.
